description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)。
description.en: Ensures request idempotence. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

descriptions.zh: 权限说明：允许数据库文件存储访问您ECS和私网连接的权限，使用该权限查询、创建、扩容、挂载、卸载、删除ECS云盘，查询、创建、删除云盘快照以及创建私网连接服务。
descriptions.en: Permission description: Grants Database File System permission to access your ECS and PrivateLink resources. This permission enables you to query, create, scale out, mount, unmount, and delete ECS cloud disks; query, create, and delete disk snapshots; and create PrivateLink services.
